scope: Matched 1000x SEM fracture images acquired and exported under the B-DQ-1-06 conditions

calibration.saved_mask_discrepancy: The reviewed TIFF retains 25 labels, while the human aggregate reports 22 correct. The aggregate 22/30 rate is used; no per-object identity is fabricated for the unresolved three.

automatic_policy.out_of_standard_action: Exclude the image from pooled statistics and report the triggered rule.

interpretation_boundary: This standard produces preliminary automated dimple-candidate estimates. It is calibrated on one B-DQ image and is not yet a publication-grade universal dimple measurement standard.
